segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Mr Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I have some pain at the knee, but it's manageable. Not too bad, doc.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the pain?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Maybe 4? The numbness from the block is still there, so it's not too painful.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any nausea or vomiting since waking up?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: A bit queasy earlier, but better now. Didn't throw up, though.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: How's your breathing? Any discomfort in your chest or throat?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Slight sore throat from the tube, but I can breathe fine.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Do you remember anything from the operation?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, everything's a blank. Woke up here, so that's good.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any issues with your blood pressure or sugar levels that you're aware of?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: My sugar was a bit high before surgery, but the nurses said they're monitoring it. BP seems okay now.
